errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge nach ihrem Wert angeordnet
errors.evidence: This statement is not true for the entire chart. The lower section of bars, representing company sizes ('Betriebsgrößen'), is not sorted by value. For instance, 'Mittlere Betriebe' has a value of approximately 39%, which is greater than 'Größere Betriebe' at approximately 36%, yet it is listed below it.

errors.text_span: der kürzeste „Baugewerbe“ mit etwa 8 Prozent zeigt
errors.evidence: The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to the category 'Bergbau' (mining), with a value of approximately 7.5%. 'Baugewerbe' (construction) has a value of about 8% and is not the shortest bar.

The categories on the y-axis are not sorted alphabetically. The top section (industries) is sorted in descending order of value, and the bottom section (company sizes) is sorted by the size of the company from largest to smallest.
The bar for 'Mittlere Betriebe (50-249)' extends to approximately 39% on the x-axis, making the reported value of 'etwa 38 Prozent' an inaccurate approximation.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für die Betriebsgrößen sind ebenfalls nach ihrem Anteil absteigend angeordnet.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bars for the company sizes are not sorted in descending order of their value. For example, 'Mittlere Betriebe' (~39%) has a higher value than 'Größere Betriebe' (~36%), but is listed below it.
